# Desserts by Deniz

Welcome to *Desserts by Deniz*! Browse our selection of custom baked goods below.

::: {.callout-note}
**Note:** All orders are subject to Deniz's availability. Prices are estimates and may vary based on custom requests.
:::

</div>

## Photo Gallery

<div class="carousel">
  <!-- Carousel images will be loaded here -->
  <div class="carousel-inner">
    <div class="carousel-item active">
      <img src="https://via.placeholder.com/800x400?text=Loading+Photos..." alt="Dessert photo">

<script>
// Load menu data from Google Sheets
async function loadMenuData() {
  try {
    const sheetId = "10Lz86fUeqTrgBTdrjOa02zzM96G6_KhUVhZBbnuu940";
    const apiKey = "YOUR_API_KEY"; // Replace with your actual API key

    const response = await fetch(
      `https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/${sheetId}/values/Sheet1?key=${apiKey}`
    );

    if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch sheet data");

    const data = await response.json();
    const rows = data.values;

    // Skip header row
    const menuData = rows.slice(1).map(row => {
      const [
        occasion,
        category,
        item,
        description,
        size,
        baseCost,
        laborHours,
        hourlyRate,
        totalPrice,
        notes
      ] = row;

      return {
        occasion,
        category,
        item: `${item} (${size})`,
        description,
        baseCost: parseFloat(baseCost),
        laborHours: parseFloat(laborHours),
        hourlyRate: parseFloat(hourlyRate),
        totalPrice: parseFloat(totalPrice),
        notes
      };
    });

    // Group by occasion and category
    const groupedMenu = menuData.reduce((acc, item) => {
      if (!acc[item.occasion]) acc[item.occasion] = {};
      if (!acc[item.occasion][item.category]) acc[item.occasion][item.category] = [];
      acc[item.occasion][item.category].push(item);
      return acc;
    }, {});

    // Generate HTML table
    let tableHTML = '<table class="menu-table"><thead><tr><th>Item</th><th>Description</th><th>Price</th></tr></thead><tbody>';

    Object.entries(groupedMenu).forEach(([occasion, categories]) => {
      tableHTML += `<tr class="occasion-header"><td colspan="3">${occasion}</td></tr>`;
      Object.entries(categories).forEach(([category, items]) => {
        items.forEach(item => {
          tableHTML += `
            <tr>
              <td>${item.item}</td>
              <td>${item.description}</td>
              <td>$${item.totalPrice.toFixed(2)}</td>
            </tr>
          `;
        });
      });
    });

    tableHTML += '</tbody></table>';
    document.getElementById('menu-table').innerHTML = tableHTML;

  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error loading menu:", error);
    // Fallback to simple table if API fails
    document.getElementById('menu-table').innerHTML = `
      <table class="menu-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Item</th>
            <th>Description</th>
            <th>Price</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr>
            <td>Chocolate Cake (6-inch)</td>
            <td>Rich chocolate cake with buttercream frosting</td>
            <td>$47.50</td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <td>Vanilla Fruit Cake (8-inch)</td>
            <td>Classic vanilla with seasonal fruit</td>
            <td>$80.00</td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <td>Chocolate Chip Cookies (12)</td>
            <td>Classic cookies</td>
            <td>$18.75</td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <td>Blueberry Muffins (6)</td>
            <td>Fresh blueberry muffins</td>
            <td>$16.75</td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    `;
  }
}

// Simple image carousel
let currentSlide = 0;
const slides = [
  "https://via.placeholder.com/800x400?text=Chocolate+Cake",
  "https://via.placeholder.com/800x400?text=Cookies",
  "https://via.placeholder.com/800x400?text=Muffins"
];

function changeSlide(direction) {
  currentSlide += direction;
  if (currentSlide >= slides.length) currentSlide = 0;
  if (currentSlide < 0) currentSlide = slides.length - 1;

  const carouselInner = document.querySelector('.carousel-inner');
  carouselInner.innerHTML = `
    <div class="carousel-item active">
      <img src="${slides[currentSlide]}" alt="Dessert photo">
    </div>
  `;
}

// Initialize when page loads
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  loadMenuData();
});
</script>

<style>
.menu-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  margin: 2rem 0;
}

.menu-table th, .menu-table td {
  padding: 0.75rem;
  text-align: left;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;
}

.menu-table th {
  background-color: #f8f9fa;
  font-weight: bold;
}

.occasion-header td {
  background-color: #e9ecef;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.carousel {
  position: relative;
  max-width: 800px;
  margin: 2rem auto;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.carousel-inner {
  position: relative;
}

.carousel-item {
  display: none;
  width: 100%;
}

.carousel-item.active {
  display: block;
}

.carousel-item img {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

.carousel-control {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  color: white;
  border: none;
  padding: 1rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  z-index: 10;
}

.carousel-control.prev {
  left: 0;
}

.carousel-control.next {
  right: 0;
}
</style>
